name: inline-images
description: See pictures in the transcript, as the desktop app shows them: the images Claude reads, the ones you paste and those its answers link to; GIFs play.

rows.title: Picture height
rows.description: The most terminal rows a picture takes in the transcript.

animate.title: Play GIFs
animate.description: Play animated GIFs while they show on screen. Off, the first frame shows.

markdown.title: Pictures in answers
markdown.description: Show the local pictures an answer embeds with markdown (![alt](path)) under it, and a chip for each one it only names (a path, or a file name found under the working folder): the pointer on a chip shows the picture.

window.title: Preview in a window
window.description: Where the terminal cannot draw a picture itself (the VS Code terminal, Windows Terminal, Terminal.app…), a picture or a chip under the pointer opens at full quality in a small window of its own by the pointer, outside the terminal (macOS, Windows, WSL, and Linux with X11 and Python's tkinter). The window opens at once with a spinner, and the picture fills it. Off, the terminal shows it in cells.
